strategy.name: intraday_sma_full_rule_global_search_flat_start
strategy.description: 在 QQQ 全部批准历史上保留此前所有短均线导数用途并同时保留成本止损、SMA200 兜底、强制买回及两种普通买入。初始空仓；对 A、B、C、D、E、F、G、H、L、R 的预声明离散空间做固定种子的全域随机搜索和前沿附近变异搜索，分别优化 CAGR 与 Sharpe，并检查相同首买点下是否跑赢 Buy & Hold。
strategy.buy_rule: 初始空仓时由动态 H 日 SMA 上穿或价格上穿动态 F 三短均线平均值下方 G% 中任一规则全仓买入；已有卖出价后，再加入卖出成交价上方 R% 强制买回。
strategy.sell_rule: 持仓时 OR：成本价下方 L%；F 三短均线平均变化率连续 A 日为负且价格跌破动态 B 日 SMA；此前连续 D-1 日三短均线平均变化率为负且当日三条短 SMA 各自变化率均不高于 C%；动态 E 日 SMA 下穿。
strategy.signal_time: 每个交易日开始前，仅用截至前一交易日 Close 的历史计算该日条件单及动态阈值；指标预热不足时不生成对应条件单。
strategy.execution_time: 若前 Close 到当日 Open 已越过阈值，按当日常规时段 Open；否则常规时段调整后 OHLC 触及阈值时按精确理论阈值；零滑点、零费用；每天最多一笔成交。
strategy.position_sizing: long-only，初始 100,000 美元现金；每次全仓持有或全现金，允许小数股，不融资，现金不计息。
strategy.initial_position: 1999-03-10 起保持现金，等待每个 case 自己的第一笔普通买入；该 case 与其 Buy & Hold 均从同一笔成交开始计绩效。

financing: disabled; flat cash earns zero interest
benchmark: For every case independently, invest the same 100,000 USD in QQQ at that case's first actual ordinary buy fill; compare through 2026-08-04 Close.

reporting.reuse_review: Reuse v3 interactions and place only a compact KPI sentence before charts. Never render a per-order table; order reasons remain available only through K-line markers and saved machine ledgers.

research.hypothesis: Even if the fixed parameter attempts underperformed, some highly overfit region of the full A-H/L/R space may exceed same-entry Buy & Hold in CAGR and/or Sharpe, establishing whether the rule family has any in-sample capacity at all.
research.primary_metric: Independently maximize full-sample CAGR and Sharpe; also rank CAGR and Sharpe deltas versus each case's identical-entry Buy & Hold, and report drawdown, exposure and turnover for the formally verified frontier candidates.
research.selection_rule: Screen 50,000 fixed-seed samples across the declared discrete space, mutate the CAGR, Sharpe, delta-CAGR and delta-Sharpe frontiers for 30,000 additional unique samples, then formally verify the top three unique cases under each objective. This is stochastic global search, not exhaustive enumeration.
research.validation_plan: The compiled screening ledger must match the independent pandas ledger on golden cases. Every reported candidate must independently match PyBroker on cash, shares, equity, order dates/sides/shares/fills and trade accounting, and its formal metrics must reproduce its screening metrics within tolerance.
research.promotion_criteria: None. The user explicitly permits overfitting for this capacity test; even a winning case remains an in-sample hypothesis and cannot advance without a new locked walk-forward experiment.
research.rejection_conditions: Reject the run if sampled cases are not reproducible from the seed, any reported candidate is not from the saved sample set, any candidate lacks a normal first buy, its benchmark uses another fill, daily trading exceeds one order, screening/formal metrics disagree, or PyBroker diverges from the independent ledger.
